documents.title: Sign-in and Password Help
documents.text: Customers who forget a password can use the Forgot password option on the sign-in screen. Staff are not able to see or change passwords. If no reset message arrives, ask the customer to check the junk folder and verify the email address on file.

documents.title: Identity Check Timelines
documents.text: Identity checks are usually finished in two to three working days. Staff cannot promise that a check will pass. When a document is refused, ask the customer to send a clearer copy that matches the refusal reason.

documents.title: Payment Return Review
documents.text: Whether a payment is returned depends on the payment channel, the account state, and an internal assessment. Staff must not promise that a payout will be made. They can say the request will be assessed and that more information may be requested.

documents.title: Closing an Account
documents.text: An account can be closed by contacting support. Open cases, unpaid balances, or compliance holds can slow this down. Staff must not say a closure is instant unless the back office confirms it.
